$comment: Tests written ahead of their feature: each must FAIL until the feature is in, then come off this list. See tests/README.md (red first). Only new tests belong here; the floor guard refuses an existing test listed as pending.

pending.test: a counter refuses the N+1th room for an address and frees it when a room closes
a counter refuses more sockets than an address may hold, and more reservations than its window allows
an address list from a proxy counts by its first entry
a message bucket lets a burst of 40 through and drops the 41st within the same second
the bucket refills at 20 a second
a third table from one address is refused while two are open, and says so
the 4th socket from one address is refused when the cap is 3
a client that floods 200 moves in a second gets one notice and the room still answers it afterwards
